cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Why I missed our anniversary dinner belongs in the calendar review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're having the replacement dinner now. Explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. This booking covers dinner, not the review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll cancel dessert and we can talk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need to resolve the cancellation before opening a second complaint.

mechanism: A turns its partner calendar habits into a pupil scheduling correction, assigning questions about missed anniversary dinner to successive reviews instead of answering now.
confusable: Not offering a reason for missing dinner: every route B proposes is declared a different or premature process.
comparison: Office-like repair agenda versus procedural evasion at a personally charged replacement meal.
seedUse: D182 anniversary/replacement dinner/calendar review/dessert cancellation; S05 taught diary categories.
